title: feat(plugin-security)!: under a walled tenancy posture every external object states its organization scope
body:
Clause-②: no (narrowing) — under the `isolated` and `group` tenancy postures an external object (an `external` block) that states no organization scope is refused by name when the boot completes, and one registered after the boot is denied at Layer 0; nothing is widened, and the `single` posture is unchanged.
Metadata-protocol: narrowed
Skills-docs: follow-up #29866 — `content/docs/data-modeling/virtual-objects.mdx` (a multi-organization section), `skills/objectstack-data/rules/datasources.md` (the three declarations), `docs/adr/0015-external-datasource-federation.md` (the §10 and D7 amendment); the sibling docs PR on `claude/sec-hardening-g-docs`, governed (Tier H), landed by the maintainer's hand.

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**:在 `isolated` / `group` 租户姿态下,每个外部对象(带 `external` 块)必须声明自己的组织范围——三选一:自带 `organization_id` 字段(远端行带该列、驱动返回它;另名远端列用 `external.columnMap` 映射到它)、`tenancy: { enabled: false }`(全组织共享)、`systemFields: { tenant: false }`(同一声明,写在系统字段上)。什么都没声明的外部对象在启动完成时(`kernel:ready`)按名拒绝启动;启动后才注册的(Studio 导入、运行时数据源)在 Layer 0 判 `deny`(每次读零行、写被拒)并告警一次。外部对象上的 `tenancy.tenantField` 同样按名拒绝(墙只认 `organization_id`)。showcase 的两个联邦对象声明为共享。
- **为什么改**:外部对象没有平台存储,注册表注入的 `organization_id` 只是声明不是列;它的行属于一个组织还是所有组织,只有作者知道。规则由安全频道裁决(D1 B,D2 (c2)+(a));`single` 姿态不受影响。
- **风险与回滚**:破坏性(`!`):有墙姿态下存量的未声明外部对象会拒绝启动,错误信息列出对象名与三种声明;改元数据即可,不需要迁移数据。回滚 = 回退本 PR。
- **先看**:① `packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/external-organization-scope.ts`(一处判定 + 启动拒绝文案);② `packages/core/src/security/tenant-layer0-verdict.ts`(新的 `deny` 一阶);③ `examples/app-showcase/src/data/objects/external/*.object.ts`(声明)。
- **两分钟验证**:`OS_TENANCY_POSTURE=isolated OS_PLATFORM_OWNER_EMAIL=you@example.com pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime exec vitest run src/plugin-driver-external-object.spike.test.ts` —— 预期 18/18 通过,其中 (h6) 断言拒绝启动的错误按名列出对象与三种声明。
- **需要你做的**:无,席位落地(本 PR 不触及受管面;配套的 ADR/文档 PR 另行由你落地)。

## What changes

Under a walled tenancy posture every external object states its organization scope (ADR-0015 §10, amended by the sibling docs PR).

- **`@objectstack/plugin-security`** — `external-organization-scope.ts` is the one reading of the declaration (`walled` / `shared` / `undeclared` / `tenant-field-unenforceable`), the boot refusal (`ExternalObjectOrganizationScopeUndeclaredError`, from `SecurityPlugin`'s `kernel:ready` handler beside the ADR-0131 D5 refusal; a context without hooks judges at the end of `start()`), and the three ways out as every door spells them. `getObjectSecurityMeta` reads the same predicate into the Layer 0 input and warns once for an object registered after the boot that states nothing.
- **`@objectstack/core`** — `TenantLayer0Input.externalOrganizationScopeUndeclared` (optional); set, `computeTenantLayer0Verdict` answers `deny` under a walled posture, after the tenancy opt-out and ahead of the column question and the platform-admin crossing. Omitted, every existing caller reads as before.
- **`@objectstack/spec`** — ADR-0087 D3 semantic entry `external-object-organization-scope-declared`, telling an upgrading operator what to declare.
- **`examples/app-showcase`** — `showcase_ext_customer` and `showcase_ext_order` declare `tenancy: { enabled: false }` (the remote tables carry no organization column).
- **`tenancy.tenantField` on an external object** is closed by refusal, not enforcement: the wall keys on `organization_id` alone, the one reader of a declared tenant field is storage the platform provisions, and `external.columnMap` already reaches the wall's column. Enforcing it would need the verdict schema and the deny sentinel to carry a second column.
- Not touched: `@objectstack/objectql` (the engine already withholds the driver's native scope for external objects; the floor re-applies the wall's `where`).

## Tests

- `packages/runtime/src/plugin-driver-external-object.spike.test.ts` block (h), under `isolated` with two organizations: (h1) A reads only A's rows of a walled object and the driver is asked with the organization predicate; (h2) a driver that ignores `where` stays walled; a row without the column reads to no one (h1, h2); (h3) `tenancy.enabled: false` and `systemFields.tenant: false` objects are shared; (h4) a local object stays walled; (h5) an object registered after the boot that states nothing is denied (the spec's deny sentinel, by identity, for both organizations; the remote is asked for nothing it holds); (h6) a boot holding an undeclared object, and one declaring a foreign `tenantField`, is refused by name with the three ways out. Blocks (a)–(g) boot `single` with undeclared objects and are the control.
- `packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/external-organization-scope.test.ts`: the predicate (every declaration, both `fields` shapes, the parsed-copy rule), the refusal text, the boot door through the plugin (`kernel:ready`, no-hook, `single`), the Layer 0 door (`isolated`, `group`, `tenantField`, declared shared, declared `organization_id`, `single`, local control), and the once-only warning.
- `packages/core/src/security/tenant-layer0-verdict.test.ts`: the new rung, its order, and the omitted-flag control.
- Updated: `federated-tenant-layer0.test.ts` and `tenant-layer0-verdict-on-operation.test.ts` (the undeclared external object now records `deny`), four dogfood files whose premise was the showcase object's injected `organization_id` (it now declares its scope; `federated-rls-injectors` gains the after-boot deny case).
- Readings (local, under the shared verify lock, at the merge head `691d9717` and re-run for the touched file at `11c78bbd`):

An external object stating nothing: boot came up with no refusal and no warning; a member of A and a member of B each read both rows, and the driver received no `where`. An object declaring `organization_id`: A read only A's row, B only B's; the driver received the organization predicate. After the change the same stack is refused at boot naming the object and the three ways out (block (h6)).

## Acceptance notes

- The boot refusal runs at `kernel:ready` rather than inside `start()`: the registry is still filling during `start()` (AGENTS.md, startup registry reads), and the identity-object refusal in the same plugin already judges there. The dispatch said "in `start()` beside the precedent"; the subscription is placed exactly there.
- `systemFields: false` is accepted as the third declaration (it is `systemFields.tenant: false` and more).
- An author-time `os validate` warning for an external object stating no scope would be a fourth door (class c trap, now refused loudly at boot); not added here. `carrier: none`.
- `packages/objectql/src/engine-external-tenant-scope.test.ts` and `packages/drivers/driver-sql/src/sql-driver-external-unprovisioned-sort-anchor.test.ts` copy the showcase object's former shape in local fixtures and say so; they are fixtures of that shape, not mirrors, and are left as they are.
- The spike file's `test-budget` is re-pinned from a local ratio (two boots became three); the first scheduled run that carries block (h) gives the CI reading.
